subject: Request: 3-week sprint POC extension + milestone-based credit proposal
messages:
From: Elaine Zhang <elaine@orchidtx.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orchidtx.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — short extension for sprint POC?

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the latency profile and the observability really helpful. We're nearly through the internal security review but need a little more time to run the integration tests against our telemetry pipeline.

Would Redwood be open to a short, 3-week extension of our sprint POC? We'd like to preserve the same scope (ingest + inference + dashboarding) and add one additional eval: a resiliency test with intermittent traffic.

On our side we can commit to a clear decision milestone at the end of the extension (convert to Dedicated or end the pilot). Happy to sign an addendum if that helps. Any chance you can propose a path that keeps costs contained (we're a small bioinformatics org)?

Appreciate it — Elaine
Elaine Zhang
Director of ML Platforms | Orchid Therapeutics

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Zhang <elaine@orchidtx.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orchidtx.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short extension for sprint POC?

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and glad the team found the demo useful.

We can do a 3-week extension. Two options that would keep things simple while containing cost:

1) Time-box extension (flat credit): 3 weeks, we add a $5,000 usage credit that applies to tokens and inference runtime.
2) Milestone-based credit (preferred): we provide up to 50k token credits unlocked in two milestones — 25k when the resiliency test starts, 25k when final evaluation pass completes. If Orchid converts to Redwood Dedicated within 30 days of the extension end, we apply a 12% conversion discount on the first 3 months billing.

Option 2 helps you run the resiliency test without an upfront bill and protects both sides from open-ended consumption. I can circulate a one-page addendum and a DocuSign link if you pick a path.

Two small asks on our side: 1) confirm the decision milestone (convert vs stop) at the end of the extension; 2) provide a short test-run schedule (dates) so we can reserve capacity.

If you're good with Option 2, I'll loop in Sales Ops and Legal for a quick addendum.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Quick ask — short extension for sprint POC? (Orchid)

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Orchid's ask and my proposed Option 2 (milestone credits + 12% conversion discount). Need quick thumbs: is 12% an ok standard here for a small org with potential to convert? If not, what's the acceptable floor? Also, should we offer any additional technical support hours during the extension (one-off 4hr guarantee)?

Notes:
- Attachment we expect to share: one-page addendum + SOW update (draft attached for Sales Ops).
- If we go lower than 12% I'd like an approval thread before sending to customer.

Thanks — Evelyn

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Quick ask — short extension for sprint POC? (Orchid)

Eve — 12% is slightly generous for a short 3-week bump. Recommend we split the difference: 10% conversion discount + $5k usage credit (so customer sees both an immediate credit and conversion incentive). Approve 4 hours of technical support during the extension.

If Orchid signals clear intent to convert in the first week of the extension, we can bump to 12% via manager sign-off.

Ben Carter
Head of Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Zhang <elaine@orchidtx.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orchidtx.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short extension for sprint POC?

Hi Elaine — thanks for waiting while we aligned internally. Good news: we can proceed on the milestone credit approach with the following mutually-agreed terms:

- Extension: 3 weeks, new end date 2027-07-11.
- Milestone credits: 50,000 tokens total (25k unlocked at resiliency test kickoff, 25k at final evaluation pass).
- Conversion incentive: 10% discount on the first 3 months if Orchid signs a Dedicated contract within 30 days of 2027-07-11. We will consider a manager-approved bump to 12% if you show clear intent in week 1 of the extension.
- Technical support: up to 4 hours of dedicated engineering time during the extension window to assist with the resiliency test.
- Addendum & SOW: attached (POC-extension-addendum.pdf, SOW-sprint-poc-v2.docx). Please review; I'll send a DocuSign link once you confirm.

Can you confirm the schedule for the resiliency test (preferred kickoff date) and whether Orchid accepts the 10% + 50k credit structure? If yes, I will circulate the DocuSign and reserve capacity.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC-extension-addendum.pdf (application/pdf), SOW-sprint-poc-v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
